title: Reddit Story Video Maker for iPhone
description: Turn a Reddit-style story into a narrated vertical video on iPhone with AI voiceover, synced subtitles and a background clip, ready for TikTok, Reels and Shorts.
h1: Make Reddit story videos on your iPhone
intro: A Reddit story video pairs a written post with a voiceover, large synced subtitles and a looping background clip. Brolled's Reddit Story tool builds that format on iPhone: paste or write the story, pick a voice and a background, and export a 9:16 video without opening a timeline editor.
steps: Launch Brolled and choose Reddit Story from the tool list.
Paste a post you have the right to use, or write your own story. Keep the title short; it appears as the post header.
Pick an AI voiceover and a background clip. Gameplay-style or satisfying loops keep the eye busy while viewers listen.
Play the preview to check subtitle timing, then export the vertical video and post it to TikTok, Reels or Shorts.
tips: Hook in the first line. The opening sentence decides whether people keep watching, so lead with the conflict, not the backstory.
Split long stories into parts. A 60 to 90 second part 1 with a clear cliffhanger usually performs better than a single long video.
Only use posts you wrote or have permission to reuse, and remove usernames or personal details.
faq: What is a Reddit story video?

A short vertical video that reads a Reddit-style post aloud with an AI or recorded voice, shows synced subtitles and plays a background clip underneath. The format is common on YouTube Shorts and TikTok.
Do I need to edit on a timeline?
No. Brolled generates the voiceover, subtitles and layout for you; you choose the text, voice and background and then export.
Is it free?
Brolled is free to download with 3 free credits and all tools unlocked. Free exports are SD with a watermark; a subscription removes the watermark and enables HD.

title: Beat Sync Photo Video Maker for iPhone
description: Sync photo cuts to the beat of a song on iPhone. Tap the rhythm while the track plays and Brolled lines up every transition, with no timeline editing.
h1: Sync photos to the beat on iPhone
intro: Beat-synced edits cut to the next photo exactly on the beat. Doing that on a timeline means zooming into the waveform and trimming every clip. Brolled's Beat Sync tool uses taps instead: pick a song, add photos and tap along to the rhythm. Each tap becomes a cut point, and the photos are lined up automatically.
steps: Select a track from your library and the photos you want in the edit.
Play the track and tap the screen on each beat. Every tap is recorded as a transition point.
Watch the result, redo the taps if a cut feels late, then export.
tips: Tap on the strongest beat, often the kick drum, rather than every note.
Use more photos than beats in the drop so the fastest section has enough material.
Check the music's usage rights for the platform you post on, or add a platform sound after upload.
faq: How does Beat Sync work?
You tap the screen on each beat while the song plays. Brolled captures those taps as cut points and lines up every photo transition with the rhythm automatically.
Do I need a timeline editor?
No. There is no manual trimming; the taps define the cuts.
Can I use songs from my library?
Yes, you pick a track from your library. Make sure you have the right to use it where you post.
